summary: Interpreted the VerifyLeader receipt: with the leader cut from both other voters but the two non-voters reachable, verification succeeded against a voter quorum of two (index 1); with the non-voters also cut it failed and the leader stepped down (index 3). The question is recorded as violated with the supporter-set defect asserted, citing the source path from voter-sized quorum to all-stream notification to vote counting, and keeping the lease-bounded window, absent client reads and routing-removal partition as limits.
